summary: Phase 2 Staff Health Dashboard (OSTRC-H2) tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed (overview shape+auth boundary, athletes list sorted substantial-first & desc severity, substantial list shape/sort, athlete profile with longitudinal observations, 404 unknown, 403 for athlete tokens, Phase-1 regression). Frontend: all data-testids render at 1440x900 (health-nav-btn -> /staff/health, health-kpis, substantial-section with 9 rows, health-athletes-table with 16 rows, health-profile-modal opens from BOTH substantial-<id> and health-row-<id>, closes via Escape). Overview showed 62% response, 7 with problems, 7 substantial, 1 contact request — matches Phase 1 seed context.

issues:
Radix a11y console warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' + 'Missing Description/aria-describedby'. Cause: while profileLoading is true, HealthSurveillance.js renders only

Loading profile…

without a DialogTitle/DialogDescription. Wrap the loading placeholder with a visually-hidden DialogTitle+DialogDescription to satisfy Radix. Non-blocking (modal still functions).

action_items: (Optional a11y polish) In /app/frontend/src/pages/staff/HealthSurveillance.js, when profileLoading/profile?.loading is true, render a visually-hidden DialogTitle + DialogDescription (or move DialogHeader outside the conditional) to remove Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: health_routes.py _athlete_health_summary: 'trend' is built from subs[:3][::-1] but subs is already sorted desc by submitted_at, so trend is [oldest,...newest] of the last 3 — correct.
health_routes.py staff_health_athletes: sort key uses (substantial, current_severity, is_mandatory) reverse=True — verified sorts substantial=True first, then severity desc. Good.

health_routes.py staff_substantial_problems: filters out resolved/archived and adds athlete_name/team — good. Note: filter uses $or [{substantial_problem:True},{current_severity_score:>=17}] which correctly surfaces both flags.

health_routes.py staff_health_overview: severity_distribution only counts athletes WHERE active_problems>0 (bands intentionally excludes 'none'-only athletes) — matches Phase-2 spec ('athletes with problems').

HealthSurveillance.js openProfile sets profile({loading:true}) then replaces with data — DialogContent is always rendered while profile truthy, but DialogTitle is inside the else branch. Move a hidden DialogTitle to the always-rendered path (see action item).
HealthSurveillance.js Sparkline: if trend is empty renders '—'; otherwise uses Math.max(100, ...values) as denominator so bars are correctly scaled 0-100. Good.
HealthSurveillance.js athlete row click delegates to openProfile(a.athlete_id); no stopPropagation needed since nothing else is clickable in the row — clean.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids + modal open/close from both entry points)
